name: Bone Collector
summary: At Kormek's Hut in Desolace, Bibbly F'utzbuckle is waiting on ten more kodo bones. A caravan is due any moment, and the goblin expects the bones to change the world.

sections.title: Fortune in Old Bones
sections.body: Bibbly F'utzbuckle sees a fortune in the kodo bones around the hut. Customers turn them into furniture, musical instruments, and even blasting powder. So Bibbly sends you south to the Kodo Graveyard for ten bones, promising something in return.

sections.title: A Caravan on the Way
sections.body: A caravan comes by Kormek's Hut to collect Bibbly's kodo bones. It sells them at Shadowprey Village, and it is due any moment. Bibbly is ten bones short of a career high.

sections.title: Bibbly's Big Dreams
sections.body: When the bones arrive, Bibbly imagines the chaps back home seeing Bibbly's face across Goblin'preneur. Then they will know Bibbly has become the richest goblin in the world. A physical education teacher once said Bibbly would never amount to anything.

faq.answer: Bibbly F'utzbuckle is a goblin at Kormek's Hut in Desolace who sees a fortune in kodo bones and seeks ten more.

faq.q: Why does Bibbly need kodo bones?
aliases: what are kodo bones used for
faq.answer: Bibbly's customers make furniture, musical instruments, and even blasting powder from kodo bones.

faq.q: Where do the kodo bones go after Bibbly gets them?
faq.answer: A caravan collects Bibbly's kodo bones and sells them at Shadowprey Village.

faq.q: Where can the kodo bones be found?
faq.answer: The Kodo Graveyard lies south of Kormek's Hut in Desolace. Bibbly sends you there to gather bones.
Kormek's Hut is in Desolace, north of the Kodo Graveyard.
